name: ScatterGather
summary: Sends a message to several recipients and assembles their replies, so that the best or the fullest answer can be taken from a set of candidates.

roles.name: ScatterGather
roles.summary: The participant that broadcasts a request and aggregates the replies. It differs from a composed message processor in what is distributed: there, the parts of one message; here, the whole message to several parties who each answer.
